calendar.application: Shared US equity RTH schedule, not a symbol-specific halt feed.
calendar.bar_grid: Session open + 5 minutes through close inclusive, every 5 minutes; exact set equality, uniqueness, valid OHLCV and closed session required.

intraday.end_unit: Unix epoch milliseconds, absolute UTC instant
intraday.timestamp_semantics: close/end; source time_key unchanged, interpreted in America/New_York

daily.session_semantics: Source date mapped to ISO exchange session date; raw time_key is local midnight, not a bar close.

acquisition.daily_widening_reason: User-permitted larger daily window to obtain complete auto-saved raw output; only September onward completed sessions normalized.

processing_failures_preserved.error: Shell unexpected EOF; no normalization performed.
Long command/heredoc truncated; Python SyntaxError before execution. Switched to temporary script confined to allowed raw directory.

limitations: Tiny survivor-selected two-stock ORB scope (AAPL, NVDA); SPY is the comparison/noise-area instrument. Not a point-in-time market-wide universe.

No point-in-time fundamentals, market capitalization, historical universe membership or delistings acquired or validated. Provider ancillary PE/turnover-rate fields are not point-in-time eligibility evidence.
Five-minute close-bar stop/decision latency differs from one-minute execution and a continuously supervised sentinel. Intrabar path and actual fills are unknown.
Only 33 shared intraday sessions and 54 normalized daily sessions. Short lookback and holdout cannot establish Sharpe, edge, robustness or release readiness. No holdout split is certified.
New requests use autype=0 (unadjusted). Splits, dividends and other corporate actions remain unverified. No total-return or corporate-action validation claim.
Range queries ignore num=370, cap silently at 1000 and report has_more=false even when truncated. Completeness requires explicit calendar grids, never reliance on pagination.
Prior one-minute range failures remain preserved and explicitly incomplete. No forward filling, interpolation, synthetic data or missing-session substitution.
Daily Nov 17 was the current/incomplete session at retrieval and is excluded. Earlier daily rows were fetched only to trigger raw auto-saving and excluded from normalized daily scope.
Genuine MCP acquisitions, not independently cross-vendor audited. Calendar/shape checks are dataset checks, not strategy, fill, corporate-action or release validation.

Existing load_csv ingestion accepts ISO timestamps and requires an explicit adapter for epochs. Normalized end intentionally uses requested epoch milliseconds; downstream must convert absolute UTC epoch milliseconds to aware America/New_York close timestamps. Source was not changed.
blockers_for_release: No point-in-time universe, fundamentals or delisting evidence

Full backtesting pipelines and release validation outside dataset-only scope
